children: Zoomcar completed the sixth closing of its Series A private placement, raising approximately $155,000 by selling 156 Units at $1,000 each. Each Unit includes a preferred share convertible at $0.05 and a warrant exercisable at $0.0625, with the broader Offering sized up to $5 million plus a $5 million overallotment option and scheduled to terminate on October 9, 2026. The company also entered into a registration rights agreement to register the resale of underlying common shares and formalized a placement agent agreement with ThinkEquity, which includes cash fees and warrant compensation. These agreements aim to bolster liquidity while providing investors with defined conversion and resale pathways.
